name: Keeping the mind yoked (yukta manas)
method_summary: As stated in the simile only: understanding as charioteer holds the reins of the mind so that the senses obey; the text gives no technique here, only the condition and its result (reaching the highest place, no rebirth).

name: Restraining speech in the mind, and the mind in ever finer selves (Kaṭha 1.3.13)
method_summary: The discerning one restrains speech in the mind, that in the self that is knowledge, that in the great self, and that in the peaceful self; the text states the sequence only.
